e.title: **德语退休缺口计算器：把模型假设逐条写进 README，**并把不用的模块标成不用****：仓库 `MaTeuff-bot/rentenlueckenrechner`——**⭐ 逐字声明**「**Die Ergebnisse sind Modellrechnungen, keine Finanzberatung oder Prognosen.**」**；**⭐ 数据许可与代码许可**分开写**（**JST 衍生序列逐字为**「**Commercial use: not allowed**」**）**；**⭐ 一张**德国法定定期生命表 2023／2025**只用来显示生存概率、**逐字写明它**不改变财务模拟****；**⚠️ 而 `DATA_LICENSES.md` 指向的 `LICENSE` 文件**实测并不存在**
e.title_en: A German retirement-gap calculator that writes its model assumptions into the readme one by one, separates data licensing from code licensing while stating that the derived data may not be used commercially, and uses a German statutory period life table only to display survival probabilities while saying explicitly that the life table does not change the financial simulation.
e.title_hk: **德語退休缺口計算器：把模型假設逐條寫進 README，**並把不用的模組標成不用****：倉庫 `MaTeuff-bot/rentenlueckenrechner`——**⭐ 逐字聲明**「**Die Ergebnisse sind Modellrechnungen, keine Finanzberatung oder Prognosen.**」**；**⭐ 資料許可與代碼許可**分開寫**（**JST 衍生序列逐字為**「**Commercial use: not allowed**」**）**；**⭐ 一張**德國法定定期生命表 2023／2025**只用來顯示生存機率、**逐字寫明它**不改變財務模擬****；**⚠️ 而 `DATA_LICENSES.md` 指向的 `LICENSE` 文件**實測並不存在**
e.summary: **rentenlueckenrechner**（`MaTeuff-bot/rentenlueckenrechner`，**德语，逐字标题** Persönlicher Ruhestandsplaner**）**是一个**退休缺口计算器**（**Vite ＋ React ＋ TypeScript**）****——**⭐ 逐字自述用途**「**Er schätzt die Netto-Rentenlücke und das benötigte Kapital zum Rentenbeginn und zeigt Vermögensverläufe, Kennzahlen und eine Jahrestabelle.**」**，**并逐字声明性质**「**Die Ergebnisse sind Modellrechnungen, keine Finanzberatung oder Prognosen.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-13、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 TypeScript**；**tarball 130 条路径**（**`src/features/rentenluecke/` 下按功能分层、**含测试、**两个 GitHub Actions（**pages 与 pr**）**）**；**⚠️ 仓库内**没有 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 而 `DATA_LICENSES.md` 逐字写着代码许可在 `LICENSE`**，**实测该文件不存在**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**母语：同一个专业，用不同语言写出来**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **假设逐条写进 README**（**收益作用于年初资本、**存取发生在年末、**只有一个全局月储蓄额、**TER 在不同来源下是否扣减不同**）**；**② **数据许可独立于代码许可**，**并逐字标注**「**Commercial use: not allowed**」**；**③ **生命表只显示生存概率、**逐字写明**不改变财务模拟****。**⚠️ 本次未运行该应用。
e.summary_hk: **rentenlueckenrechner**（`MaTeuff-bot/rentenlueckenrechner`，**德語，逐字標題** Persönlicher Ruhestandsplaner**）**是一個**退休缺口計算器**（**Vite ＋ React ＋ TypeScript**）****——**⭐ 逐字自述用途**「**Er schätzt die Netto-Rentenlücke und das benötigte Kapital zum Rentenbeginn und zeigt Vermögensverläufe, Kennzahlen und eine Jahrestabelle.**」**，**並逐字聲明性質**「**Die Ergebnisse sind Modellrechnungen, keine Finanzberatung oder Prognosen.**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-13、最後推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**TypeScript**；**tarball 130 條路徑**（**含測試與兩個 GitHub Actions**）**；**⚠️ 倉庫內**沒有 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 而 `DATA_LICENSES.md` 逐字寫著代碼許可見 `LICENSE`，**實測該文件不存在**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**母語：同一個專業，用不同語言寫出來**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **假設逐條寫進 README**（**收益作用於年初資本、**存取發生在年末、**只有一個全域月儲蓄額、**TER 在不同來源下是否扣減不同**）**；**② **資料許可獨立於代碼許可**，**並逐字標註**「**Commercial use: not allowed**」**；**③ **生命表只顯示生存機率、**逐字寫明**不改變財務模擬****。**⚠️ 本次未運行該應用。
e.summary_en: The repository rentenlueckenrechner, titled in German as a personal retirement planner, **is a retirement-gap calculator built with Vite, React and TypeScript**, described verbatim as estimating the net pension gap and the capital required at the start of retirement while showing wealth trajectories, key figures and an annual table, and stating verbatim that the results are model calculations rather than financial advice or forecasts. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-13**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily TypeScript, **a hundred and thirty paths in the extracted archive** with feature-scoped source, tests and two continuous-integration workflows, and **no licence file in the repository even though the bundled data-licence document states that the code licence is in one**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.** **Three things are worth reading**: the model assumptions are written into the readme one by one, including that returns act on capital at the start of the year while contributions and withdrawals occur at the end, that there is a single global monthly savings rate, and that costs are deducted differently depending on the return source; data licensing is separated from code licensing with an explicit statement that commercial use of the derived data is not allowed; and a German statutory period life table is used only to display survival probabilities, with an explicit statement that the life table does not change the financial simulation. **The application was not run this round.**
e.body:
**rentenlueckenrechner**（GitHub 仓库 `MaTeuff-bot/rentenlueckenrechner`，**全文德语**，**逐字标题** `Persönlicher Ruhestandsplaner`**）**是一个**退休缺口计算器****——**README 逐字自述为**「**Der Rentenlückenrechner ist eine Vite/React/TypeScript-App zur vereinfachten Ruhestandsplanung. Er schätzt die Netto-Rentenlücke und das benötigte Kapital zum Rentenbeginn und zeigt Vermögensverläufe, Kennzahlen und eine Jahrestabelle. Die Ergebnisse sind Modellrechnungen, keine Finanzberatung oder Prognosen.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-08-13、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 TypeScript**；**tarball 130 条路径**；**⚠️ 仓库内**没有 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 见下**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**母语：同一个专业，用不同语言写出来**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`package.json`、`DATA_LICENSES.md`、`AGENTS.md` 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 模型假设被逐条写进 README，**包括时间顺序**——**逐字**：**「**Die jährlichen Buchungszeilen (das Jahresledger) sind die maßgebliche Berechnungsgrundlage. Ansparphase und Ruhestand werden in Jahresschritten simuliert; Kennzahlen, Diagramm und Tabelle leiten sich aus den Simulationsergebnissen ab. **Renditen wirken auf das Kapital am Jahresanfang, Einzahlungen und Entnahmen erfolgen am Jahresende.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**收益作用于年初资本、**存取发生在年末**」**这句话**决定了每一年的结果**，**而**很多计算器**恰恰不写它**——**⭐ 这与本站第 330 轮「**假设**」、第 340 轮「**把每个数从哪来写在旁边**」同向**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 数据许可与代码许可**分开，**并写明商业限制****——**`DATA_LICENSES.md` 逐字**：**「**This repository separates application code licensing from bundled dataset licensing.**」**；**对 JST 宏观史数据库 R.6 的衍生序列逐字给出**：**来源网址、**所用文件 `JSTdatasetR6.dta`、**许可信号**「**Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)**」、**以及**「**Commercial use: not allowed for this bundled derived dataset.**」**；**⭐ 并逐字给出一个**可替换性**的判断**「**The calculator treats JST as a replaceable dataset provider. A future commercial version can replace the non-commercial JST-derived snapshots with a commercially licensed or permissively licensed provider without changing the historical bootstrap model.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄的地方是**它区分了三件事**：**代码的许可、**数据集的许可、**以及**数据源是否可替换****——**⭐ 与之对照**：**本次实测**仓库内**并没有 `LICENSE` 文件**，**而 `DATA_LICENSES.md` 逐字写着代码「**covered by the repository’s code license in `LICENSE`, if present**」**——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这一处不闭合**，**不替它解释**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 生命表被明确限定**只用于显示**，**不进入财务模拟****——**逐字**：**「**Optional lässt sich die Überlebenswahrscheinlichkeit aus der gebündelten Destatis-Periodensterbetafel 2023/2025 für Deutschland anzeigen, bedingt auf das aktuelle Alter. Risikokarten verbinden diesen statistischen Kontext mit dem Aufbrauchrisiko. **Die Sterbetafel ist keine individuelle Lebenserwartungsprognose und verändert die Finanzsimulation nicht.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处尤其值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**图上同时出现生存概率与耗尽风险**」**最容易让读者以为**两者在同一模型里耦合**，**而作者**主动说明它们没有**——**⭐ 这与本站第 347 轮「**防误读**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ④ 收益来源的机制被写清**——**逐字**：**① **历史自助法**（**bootstrap**）「**zieht verfügbare Kalenderjahre mit Zurücklegen: Ein Jahr kann mehrfach vorkommen**」**（**有放回抽样，**同一年可出现多次**）**；**② **历史收益与历史通胀**共用同一个被抽中的年份**（**且限于两者的共同数据区间**）**；**③ **合成来源**按给定的收益与波动假设生成**独立路径**，**逐字说明**「**sie verkürzen den historischen Überschneidungszeitraum nicht**」**（**即**合成源不会缩短历史共同区间**）**；**④ **通胀则有一份历史来源与一个固定假设**。**⭐ 本词条认为**第 ② 点最值得抄**：**「**抽中的那一年是同一个**」**这一句**把**收益与通胀的相关性**交代掉了**——**⭐ 而**不写这句话**，**读者无从知道两者是否独立抽样**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 一处**不对称**被主动说明****——**逐字**：**「**Jeder Baustein hat ein Feld für jährliche TER/Kosten. Bei Proxy-/indexähnlichen und synthetischen Quellen wird der eingetragene Kostensatz von der Jahresrendite abgezogen. Bei den gebündelten ETF-Renditequellen gilt die TER bereits als im Kurs berücksichtigt; dort wird auch ein zusätzlich eingetragener Baustein-Kostensatz aktuell **nicht** abgezogen.**」**。**⭐ 即**同一个输入框在不同来源下**行为不同**，**而**这一点被写出来**——**⭐ 这与本站第 335 轮「**不要悄悄降级**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 数据来源的**性质**被限定**——**逐字**：**两份**打包的 ETF 参考**（`IUSQ.DE` iShares MSCI ACWI 与** `EUNM.DE` iShares MSCI EM**）来自**经调整的 Yahoo Finance 欧元 Xetra 报价**，**逐字声明**「**Sie sind keine offiziellen Fonds-NAV- oder offiziellen Total-Return-Reihen und garantieren keine vollständige Abbildung der Gesamtrendite.**」**，**并逐字说明**「**Die App ruft zur Laufzeit keine Marktdaten ab.**」**（**运行时**不抓取行情**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 结果该怎么读被写明**——**逐字**：**图上是**今日购买力的资本**；**含所选来源期望年收益的**计划值**、**中位数 **P50**、**以及 **P10–P90** 区间**；**⭐ 而**「**Aufbrauchwahrscheinlichkeit**」**被逐字定义**为「**der Anteil der Pfade mit Kapital von 0 € oder weniger zum jeweiligen Alter**」**（**某年龄时资本归零或为负的路径占比**）**；**并对**对数坐标**做了说明**（**非正资本放在轴的下缘、**过高的 P90 可为可读性截断、**且不影响 tooltip 与风险卡里的底层数值**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 边界与存储被写明**——**逐字四条**：**不做自动个人税务计算或法定 KV／PV 计算**（**可选一个引导式手工 GKV／PV 估算**）**；**不做任意实时 ETF 搜索或数据导入**；**不做个人化 ETF 回测**；**不做可选的自定义提取策略**；**⭐ 并逐字写明存储**「**Gültige Szenario-Eingaben werden ausschließlich lokal im Browser in `localStorage` gespeichert. Es gibt keine serverseitige Speicherung oder geräteübergreifende Synchronisierung**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 仓库里有两处**很当代**的痕迹（本次实测）**：**① **`AGENTS.md`**——**给 AI 编码代理的规则**，**逐字含**「**Treat the yearly ledger rows as the source of truth for calculations. Summary cards, charts, and tables should derive from the same simulation result instead of recomputing separate business logic.**」**、**「**Keep the model framework-free. Validation, normalization, deterministic simulation, required-capital search, stochastic returns, and mortality helpers belong outside React.**」**、**以及**「**UI code may orchestrate state and rendering, but should not own financial formulas.**」**；**⭐ 即**「**公式不许住进 UI**」**被写成了明文约束**；**② **`docs/insurance-capital-estimator.md`** 开头逐字为**「**PR1: inactive insurance capital-income accounting foundation. Rule verification date: 2026-09-10. This module is not imported by the application, scenario simulator, capital search, bootstrap paths, persistence, or UI. Only tests use it.**」**——**⭐ 即**一个**尚未接入**的模块**被明确标注为**未接入**，**并给出规则核对日期**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 工程形态可数**：`package.json` 逐字为**名称 **rentenlueckenrechner**、**版本 **1.0.0**、**依赖** `@vitejs/plugin-react`、`react`、`react-dom`、`recharts`、`vite`、`zod`**，**脚本** `dev`／`build`／`lint`／`preview`／`test`**，**⚠️ **`license` 字段缺失****；**另有** `eslint.config.js`、**`.github/workflows/pages.yml` 与** `pr.yml`**、**`scripts/generateDestatisLifeTable.mjs` 与** `generateHistoricalReturnData.py`**（**⭐ 后者说明历史收益数据是**脚本生成的**）**；**`AGENTS.md` 并逐字指明回生表来源为** Destatis GENESIS 数据集 `12621-0001`**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[cee-longevity-tables]]、**[[atlas-actuarial]] 属同一大类（**长寿与寿险**）**，**[[pension-pro-mcp]]、**[[openfisca]]、**[[colombian-pension-observatory]] 覆盖养老金计算与观测**，**[[mortalitytables]]、**[[longevity]]、**[[demography]]、**[[hmdhfdplus]] 覆盖生命表工具与数据**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一个面向个人的退休缺口计算器：**把假设逐条写清、**把数据许可与代码许可分开、**并把生命表限定为**只显示**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[cee-longevity-tables]]、[[mortalitytables]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的四点**：**① **现金流的时间顺序**（**收益在年初、**存取在年末**）**必须写出来**；**② **数据许可要与代码许可分开**，**而**「**这份数据不能商用**」**要写在明面上**；**③ **图上出现统计信息时**要说清它有没有进入模型**；**④ **同一个输入框在不同来源下行为不同时**，**要逐条说明**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该应用任何一步**（**未 `npm install`、**未 `npm run build`／`test`／`dev`、**未打开任何界面、**未复算任何一条路径或耗尽概率**），**故**不主张**其任何数值结果**（**⭐ 包括净缺口、**所需资本、**耗尽概率与 P10／P50／P90 区间**）**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何源码正文**——**本次只读** `README.md`、**`package.json`、**`DATA_LICENSES.md`、**`AGENTS.md`、**`docs/insurance-capital-estimator.md` **开头**、**以及 tarball 路径列表**；**未打开** `src/` **下任何 `.ts`／`.tsx`、**两个生成脚本、**两份 workflow、**`docs/gkv-pv-rules-2026.md`，**也**未看**任何测试文件正文**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `AGENTS.md` **中所述「**财务公式不得住在 UI 里**」**在代码里**是否**真的成立**（**⭐ 本词条只核实该文件存在与其**明文规则**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `docs/insurance-capital-estimator.md` **所述「**该模块未被应用、**模拟器、**资本搜索、**bootstrap、**持久化与 UI 引用，**仅测试使用**」**这一说法**——**⭐ 本词条只读该文档开头**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**生命表**的实际来源与结构**（**⭐ `AGENTS.md` 指为 Destatis GENESIS `12621-0001`**，**但**本次**未访问该数据集、**也未读生成的 TS 文件**）**；**也未核实**「**2023/2025**」**这一区间**的具体含义**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实两份 ETF 参考序列的**口径**（**⭐ README 明说它们**不是官方 NAV／总回报序列**，**本词条**只转述**）**；**也未核实** Yahoo Finance **条款**与 `DATA_LICENSES.md` **所述是否一致**。**⑦ ⚠️ **权利状态不正常**：**仓库内没有 `LICENSE` 文件**，**而 `DATA_LICENSES.md` 逐字指向「**the repository’s code license in `LICENSE`, if present**」**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这一处不闭合**，**并按惯例记为**权利不明**——⭐ 这**不等于**作者放弃权利**；**⚠️ 复用其代码前须先取得作者许可**；**⚠️ 数据一侧更受限**（**JST 衍生序列**不得商用**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与机构**；**★0**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**本项目**文档质量明显高于其使用规模**，**其价值在**如何把假设与许可写清楚**，**而不在**是否已被人使用****。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核实该计算器与**德国法定养老金规则**（**如 2026 年 GKV／PV 规则**）**的对应关系**（**⭐ `docs/gkv-pv-rules-2026.md` 存在，**但本次未读**）**——**⚠️ 本条**不得**被理解为任何养老金或税务意见**。**⑩ ⚠️ 创建 2026-08-13 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**一个个人向退休模型：**把时间顺序等假设逐条写出、**把数据许可与代码许可分开并标注不得商用、**并把生命表限定为只显示不进模型**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该应用自己就写着结果不是建议也不是预测**。
e.body_hk:
**rentenlueckenrechner**（GitHub 倉庫 `MaTeuff-bot/rentenlueckenrechner`，**全文德語**，**逐字標題** `Persönlicher Ruhestandsplaner`**）**是一個**退休缺口計算器****——**README 逐字自述為**「**Der Rentenlückenrechner ist eine Vite/React/TypeScript-App zur vereinfachten Ruhestandsplanung. Er schätzt die Netto-Rentenlücke und das benötigte Kapital zum Rentenbeginn und zeigt Vermögensverläufe, Kennzahlen und eine Jahrestabelle. Die Ergebnisse sind Modellrechnungen, keine Finanzberatung oder Prognosen.**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-08-13、最後推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**TypeScript**；**tarball 130 條路徑**；**⚠️ 倉庫內**沒有 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 見下**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**母語：同一個專業，用不同語言寫出來**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`package.json`、`DATA_LICENSES.md`、`AGENTS.md` 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 模型假設逐條寫進 README，**包括時間順序****——**逐字**「**Die jährlichen Buchungszeilen (das Jahresledger) sind die maßgebliche Berechnungsgrundlage. Ansparphase und Ruhestand werden in Jahresschritten simuliert; Kennzahlen, Diagramm und Tabelle leiten sich aus den Simulationsergebnissen ab. Renditen wirken auf das Kapital am Jahresanfang, Einzahlungen und Entnahmen erfolgen am Jahresende.**」**——**⭐ 「**收益作用於年初資本、**存取發生在年末**」**決定了每一年的結果**，**而**很多計算器不寫它****。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 資料許可與代碼許可**分開，**並寫明商業限制****——**`DATA_LICENSES.md` 逐字**「**This repository separates application code licensing from bundled dataset licensing.**」**；**對 JST 宏觀史 R.6 衍生序列逐字給出來源網址、**所用檔案 `JSTdatasetR6.dta`、**許可信號**「**CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**」**、**以及**「**Commercial use: not allowed for this bundled derived dataset.**」**；**⭐ 並逐字給出**可替換性**判斷**「**The calculator treats JST as a replaceable dataset provider. A future commercial version can replace the non-commercial JST-derived snapshots with a commercially licensed or permissively licensed provider without changing the historical bootstrap model.**」**。**⭐ 即**它區分了三件事**：**代碼許可、**資料集許可、**資料源是否可替換****；**⭐ 而本次實測**倉庫內並無 `LICENSE` 文件**，**而該文件逐字寫著代碼「**covered by the repository’s code license in `LICENSE`, if present**」**——**⭐ 本詞條**如實記錄這處不閉合**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 生命表被限定**只用於顯示**，**不進入財務模擬****——**逐字**「**Optional lässt sich die Überlebenswahrscheinlichkeit aus der gebündelten Destatis-Periodensterbetafel 2023/2025 für Deutschland anzeigen, bedingt auf das aktuelle Alter. The repository rentenlueckenrechner, written entirely in German and titled as a personal retirement planner, **is a retirement-gap calculator built with Vite, React and TypeScript**, described verbatim as estimating the net pension gap and the capital required at the start of retirement while showing wealth trajectories, key figures and an annual table, and stating verbatim that the results are model calculations rather than financial advice or forecasts. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-08-13**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily TypeScript, **a hundred and thirty paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file**, while the bundled data-licence document refers to a code licence file that does not exist. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the package manifest, the data-licence document, the agent instructions file and the file listing**: **first, the model assumptions are written into the readme one by one, including the ordering in time**: verbatim, the annual ledger rows are the authoritative basis for calculation, the accumulation and retirement phases are simulated in yearly steps, the key figures, chart and table derive from the simulation results, **returns act on capital at the start of the year while contributions and withdrawals occur at the end of the year**. **That sentence determines every year of the projection, and it is exactly the sentence most calculators omit.** **Second, data licensing is separated from code licensing and the commercial restriction is stated**: the data-licence document says verbatim that the repository separates application code licensing from bundled dataset licensing; for the derived return snapshots it gives the source address, the dataset file used, the licence signal as a Creative Commons non-commercial share-alike licence, and the sentence that commercial use is not allowed for the bundled derived dataset; and it adds a replaceability judgement verbatim, that the calculator treats that database as a replaceable dataset provider, so a future commercial version can substitute a commercially licensed provider without changing the historical bootstrap model. **Three things are therefore distinguished: the code licence, the dataset licence, and whether the data source can be swapped. Against that, this entry measured that no licence file exists in the repository while the data-licence document states that the code is covered by one, and records the gap without explaining it away.** **Third, the life table is confined to display and does not enter the financial simulation**: verbatim, the survival probability from a bundled German statutory period life table for 2023 and 2025 can optionally be shown conditioned on current age, risk cards connect that statistical context to depletion risk, and the life table is not an individual life-expectancy forecast and does not change the financial simulation. **Showing survival probability and depletion risk on the same screen most easily suggests that the two are coupled inside one model, and the author states in advance that they are not.** **Fourth, the return-generation mechanics are written out**: the historical bootstrap draws available calendar years **with replacement**, so one year can occur several times; historical return sources and historical inflation share the same drawn year from their common data range; synthetic sources generate separate paths from given return and volatility assumptions under a simplified normal distribution and, verbatim, do not shorten the historical overlap period; and inflation offers one historical source and one fixed assumption. **The sentence that the drawn year is the same one disposes of the correlation question between returns and inflation, which a reader otherwise cannot answer.** **Fifth, an asymmetry is stated rather than hidden**: verbatim, every portfolio building block has an annual cost field, for proxy or index-like and synthetic sources the entered cost rate is subtracted from the annual return, whereas for the bundled exchange-traded-fund return sources the total expense ratio already counts as included in the price and an additionally entered block cost rate is currently not subtracted there. **The same input field therefore behaves differently depending on the source, and that is written down.** **Sixth, the nature of the data is qualified**: the two bundled fund reference profiles are derived from adjusted market prices in euros on a German exchange, with the statement verbatim that they are not official fund net asset value or official total-return series and do not guarantee a complete representation of total return, and that the application fetches no market data at runtime. **Seventh, how to read the results is stated**: capital is shown in today purchasing power, with the plan value using the expected annual return of the selected sources, the median, and a tenth-to-ninetieth percentile band, and the depletion probability is defined verbatim as the share of paths with capital of zero euros or less at each age, together with an explanation of how the logarithmic axis handles non-positive values and why very high upper-band values may be capped for readability without changing the underlying values in tooltips and risk cards. **Eighth, limits and storage are stated**: no automatic personal tax calculation and no statutory health or long-term-care insurance calculation, though an optional guided manual estimate is offered; no arbitrary live fund search or data import; no individual fund backtest; and no selectable personalised withdrawal strategy, with valid scenario inputs stored **only locally in the browser**, with no server-side storage and no cross-device synchronisation. **Ninth, two very contemporary artefacts were measured in the repository**: an agent instructions file for AI coding assistants, stating verbatim that the yearly ledger rows are the source of truth for calculations and that summary cards, charts and tables should derive from the same simulation result instead of recomputing separate business logic, that the model must stay framework-free with validation, normalisation, deterministic simulation, required-capital search, stochastic returns and mortality helpers outside React, and that user-interface code may orchestrate state and rendering but should not own financial formulas; and a documentation file opening with a numbered change note recording that the module is an inactive insurance capital-income accounting foundation with a rule-verification date, that it is not imported by the application, the scenario simulator, the capital search, the bootstrap paths, the persistence layer or the user interface, and that only tests use it. **A module that is not wired in is therefore labelled as not wired in, with the date on which its rules were checked.** **Tenth, the engineering shape is countable**: the manifest gives the name, version 1.0.0, dependencies for React, charting, the build tool and schema validation, and scripts for development, build, lint, preview and test, **with no licence field**; there is a linter configuration, two continuous-integration workflows for pages and pull requests, and two data-generation scripts, one for the life table and one for the historical return series, the agent instructions further naming the statistical office dataset from which the mortality data is generated. **Eleventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover longevity and life-insurance tooling, pension calculation and observation, and life-table tooling and data, **while this entry supplies a personal retirement-gap calculator that writes its assumptions out one by one, separates data licensing from code licensing with an explicit non-commercial flag, and confines the life table to display. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled longevity and life-table entries**; **four practices transfer directly: write out the ordering in time of cash flows, such as returns at the start of the year and contributions and withdrawals at the end; separate data licensing from code licensing and put a non-commercial restriction where it can be seen; say whether a statistic shown on a chart entered the model or not; and document each case where one input field behaves differently depending on the source**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the application was not run at all** — no dependency installation, no build, test or development server, no interface opened and no path or depletion probability recomputed — **so none of its numerical results is claimed, including the net gap, the required capital, the depletion probability and the percentile band**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the readme, the package manifest, the data-licence document, the agent instructions file, the opening of one documentation file and the archive path list were read, and no TypeScript source, no generation script, no workflow and no statutory-rules document was opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the rule that financial formulas must not live in the user interface actually holds in the code was not verified**, only the existence of the rule and its text. **Fourth, the statement that the insurance capital module is imported only by tests was not verified**, only the opening of that document being read. **Fifth, the actual source and structure of the life table were not verified**, since neither the statistical office dataset nor the generated file was inspected, nor was the meaning of the stated two-year range. **Sixth, the conventions behind the two fund reference series were not verified, nor were the market-data provider terms compared against the data-licence document. Seventh, the rights position is abnormal**: no licence file is present, while the data-licence document points to one that would be there if present; **this entry records the gap and marks the rights as unclear, which is not the same as the author waiving rights**, so reuse of the code requires the author permission first, and the data side is more restricted still because the derived series may not be used commercially. **Eighth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified, and this entry notes that the project documentation considerably exceeds its usage, so its value lies in how assumptions and licences are written down rather than in adoption.** **Ninth, the correspondence between this calculator and German statutory pension rules was not verified**, the relevant rules document existing but not being read, **so nothing here may be read as pension or tax advice. Tenth, the creation date of 2026-08-13 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-10 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is a personal retirement model that writes its assumptions out item by item, separates data licensing from code licensing with a non-commercial flag, and confines a life table to display, which had no counterpart in the pool. Eleventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and notes that the application itself states that its results are neither advice nor forecasts.**
